suggestions: Region bands are narrower than the label span they contain, so the outermost labels overhang the band rectangle (classic k_silence and k_s3 on the right; tbpn path_bridge, s_firewall, s_parts). Widening the regions to about [-95,95] or pulling those nodes inward by ~8 units would keep every label inside the band that explains it.
The long solid rests_on edges span three levels and cut diagonally across the assumed-failure and pathway bands, passing over their captions; edge routing is engine-level, not patchable on this page.

Engine-level: the CSS2D label offset puts the top sub-row of each band hard against that band lower border line. A slightly larger offset, or drawing region borders beneath labels, would give cleaner band edges across the library.

Engine-level: snap.mjs only ever opens a derived node panel, so the fact panel quote-plus-reference rendering can only be verified indirectly. A fact-node panel shot would close that gap for every framework.

In tbpn facts-only, 5 of the 8 surviving causes have no fact edge, because the source states those conditions without tying them to the plan. The band caption carries the reading, but it is the one place where the facts-only skeleton is a list rather than a structure.
viz_reviews.summary: Five-band downward tree, each band captioned by its move in the technique; the inversion is the only edge crossing band 0 to band 1. The facts-only view is the strongest thing: the camera holds its framing so the pathway and safeguard bands empty out in place while their captions stay, which turns the framework central claim into a picture. The three idea-bearing safeguards are gold-ringed, not clipped, with clear frame beneath. Metrics clean in both examples at default, console empty, embedded data byte-identical to graph.json, stats line matches. Legibility 4 rather than 5 only for the long rests_on edges crossing two bands and the outermost labels overhanging their band rectangles; both cosmetic and neither worth another iteration.

notes:
Research: Inversion (Jacobi's 'invert, always invert'; Munger's 'all I want to know is where I'm going to die, so I'll never go there') plus Gary Klein's pre-mortem, HBR September 2007. Klein's five steps: know the plan; assert the fiasco ('it is a year later and the project has failed'); each member independently writes every reason; consolidate; revisit the plan and engineer safeguards. Mechanism is prospective hindsight (Mitchell, Russo and Pennington 1989: imagining an outcome as already realised raises the ability to name correct reasons by about 30%). It differs from a risk register because failure is asserted as fact, which licenses concrete narrative and lets dissenters speak without disloyalty.

Provenance consequence, decided here: the source gives the plan and the visible risks (goal and most causes are facts); the inversion, the pathways and every safeguard are LLM reasoning. Idea-bearing slot is safeguard: a missing safeguard is often a product someone could sell. Three of the four TBPN safeguards carry an idea (s_parts, s_bond, s_permit).

Graph verification pass (step 4, after the writing agent was interrupted). Validator: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Changes made in this pass, all before the scaffold commit:
- s_firewall label was 41 characters (the one warning); shortened to 'Ring-fence airliner from turbine cash' (37), meaning preserved.
- Edge fe1 (p_ramp rests_on c_demand) was marked fact but its quote was only c_demand's own assertion; the speaker never states that the ramp depends on the demand, and the two claims sit ~180 lines apart. Reclassified derived at 0.70 per SPEC 3 ('a sequence read from narrative order' is derived). The remaining five TBPN fact edges each contain a real connective in one turn ('the capital to go do that', 'So we're done fundraising', 'copy paste into the facility that will do 2 gigawatts', 'it literally prints the cash').
- Classic fact edges kf5 and kf6 had enclosing spans rather than connectives; both extended to start at 'The director notes three things for the record:' so the clause that attaches the condition to the plan is inside the quote. Still verbatim.
- c_permits: node text said 'the biggest problem with building anything physical'; the speaker says 'a huge problem' and 'much bigger than energy production'. Text corrected and source_ref widened to L4576-L4606, which is where 'such huge delays and huge costs' actually sits.

Confidence discipline, the thing most at risk in this framework. Rule applied and held: no pathway anywhere in the library sits above 0.65, because a pathway is a constructed narrative even when its ingredients are quoted. k_p1 was lowered 0.70 -> 0.65 (and its edge ke2 with it) because it adds three unstated steps to one stated condition. path_customer sits at 0.55 because the source explicitly denies demand risk. The assumed failure 'fail' was lowered 0.75 -> 0.70 (and edge te1 with it): the inversion is mandated by the method, but the 2028 date and the ordering of the collapse are a judgement. Safeguards are split on a principle: a safeguard that is the direct inversion of an explicitly named gap sits at 0.70-0.75 (k_s1 volume test, k_s2 retention, k_s3 abort criteria), while a safeguard that invents a mechanism nobody mentioned sits at 0.55-0.65 (s_bond, s_permit, s_parts, s_firewall). Every TBPN safeguard is in the lower band, which is correct: none of them is in the source.

One deliberate asymmetry between the examples. In the classic, k_fiasco is a fact node in the assumed_failure slot, because the source is itself a pre-mortem: the director asserts the fiasco out loud. In the TBPN example the same slot is derived, because Scholl does the opposite of a pre-mortem on camera ('basically inevitable'). The pair is the point of the framework page: it shows what the slot looks like when the room has run the exercise and when it has not.

Registry deviation: added relation 'rests_on' beyond the registry's four, for the dependency a source states about its own plan. Without it the goal-to-cause links have no relation to use and every one of them would have to be derived, which would hide the fact skeleton this framework is supposed to expose. Registry slot ids are unchanged.

Viz: passed on iteration 1, scores 5/5/4/5, no blocking issues. Tree, direction down, five captioned band regions per example, explicit pos on every node because the engine automatic spread cannot separate nine causes on one level. The builder removed layout.camera.distance from both examples so the engine auto-fit runs, which its geometry is tuned to. Two cosmetic items were left deliberately and are not defects: the outermost labels overhang the band tint (the builder measured that widening the regions to contain them would cost about 13% of scale, because the camera fits the regions too), and the long rests_on edges cross the two intervening bands, which is engine-level edge routing. The critic judged both not worth another iteration.

Reconcile: README verified against graph.json by script over every node text, label, source_quote, source_ref, confidence, rationale and idea, and every edge id plus every fact-edge quote: no mismatches. All eighteen SPEC 6 headings present in order, one mermaid diagram, the stated counts (classic 18 nodes 9f/9d and 32 edges 8f/24d; tbpn 22 nodes 12f/10d and 38 edges 5f/33d) all correct. Every relative link resolves on disk and the wikipedia reference returns 200. The layout-only invariant holds: graph.json with layout, pos, level, order, size, label, slot colour and slot shape stripped is identical to the last content commit be85fe0. validate 0 errors 0 warnings, build clean, embedded data byte-identical to graph.json. No labels were shortened by the viz builder, so no README label updates were needed. Exactly four files in the folder.
Final review: removed 'Overture' and 'Superpower' from entities on p_product, p_bridge, fail, c_confidence, path_bridge, s_firewall (not extraction spellings for 2025-12-09; entities are the merge join key). README names c_optimism as the target of te11 and te13. Validate 0 errors, snap 0 overlaps.
Insights pass (Part G): insights.short and insights.long written for both examples from the graph as it stood; no node, edge, provenance or confidence changed. TBPN short 120 words, long 349; classic short 118, long 348. Every claim traces to a node; the three idea sentences are verbatim in the TBPN long; the classic, which has no business idea, closes on the exposed rule from k_s3. README gained the What this graph derived section between the blockquote and What it decomposes. Validate 0 errors 0 warnings, build clean, snap 0 overlaps, insights card shows the long text with the derived list beneath and the header strip carries the short text.
